description: An environment's logs (or a build's: build_id), most recent first, filterable by a text.

build_id.description: To read a build's log rather than the application's.

limit.description: Lines returned: 100 by default, 200 with build_id; 1,000 at most.

query.description: A LogsQL filter (VictoriaLogs' query language: https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victorialogs/logsql/), for example "timeout"; "error": the error lines.

trial.description: The key returned by the first deploy_app (trial_key), passed again on each call.

name: get_logs
title: Read logs
